pain.author: Kevanjt
pain.raw_quote:
I love at least the idea of this app.
AllTrails tries to do everything I want it to do. Unfortunately, it doesn’t always succeed. For example, it’s sort of a mess to use on my first gen Apple Watch Ultra. My watch is constantly getting disconnected from my phone, but only for AllTrails. And then when the trail is finished, my watch never gets the memo. Every single time, I have to restart my watch to get all trails to quit running in the background. Frustrating.

It does work very well on my iPhone, though. I haven’t decided if I will renew my AllTrails+ subscription. I love being able to download maps before a trip. But the watch thing is annoying. Precise GPS tracking was my primary motivation for purchasing the Ultra. Wish AllTrails worked better with it.

emotion.raw_quote:
Almost feels like cheating
Having the app is such a great companion when hiking. So many times it’s prevented me from taking the wrong turn and having to backtrack or worse getting lost. Setting waypoint for hikes, that you repeat is a great benefit. The app seems to work even with poor signal and for 35 bucks a year it’s pretty decent value. And of course there’s the database of hikes that you can search for places that you’ve never been before as well as discovering things right in your own backyard. i’ve also used it for bushwhacking and navigating to a destination through the woods with no trails. It’s a great tool for that as well.

emotion.author: jmazeing
emotion.raw_quote:
Falling back in love with Day One
I used Day One years ago when it first came out and recently decided to give it another try and I am blown away by all the functionality. My favorite feature is the ability to write my entries with my Apple Pencil. There is something about handwriting my entries that makes journaling more enjoyable for me. So I have been using paper journals to capture thoughts but now I finally have the ability to go paperless and still get the experience I want coupled with the ability to type, add pictures and voice memos to entries. Plus it is easy to capture moments anytime on my iPhone or iPad. I am back in love with Day One!

rel5.author: noushapsidnbbz
rel5.raw_quote:
Awesome App…perhaps one improvement
This is THE best app for hikers scouting nearby - or wherever, for that matter - trails to hike, bike or walk. Good detail, lots of good and helpful comments from other hikers/bikers, navigates to trail head (about 85% accurate in my experience) and will track your route along the trail. How could it be any better…?  It would be very helpful if there was info on access to trail head. Example: when my wife and I were hiking in Idaho, this app showed us lots of cool trails BUT quite a few of them were inaccessible unless you had an some off-road worthy vehicle. We did not, so we had to abandon those hiking plans after we got in the area and realized we could not get to the trail head.
